# Rules applied: real maker oval (blue-filled or recognisable at 1x) = QUALITY-FAIL; blank or chrome oval with no characters = ADVISORY; police-utility silhouette with no badge/lettering/equipment/light bar/push bar = ADVISORY; visible police equipment = SCRIPT-DRIFT; readable letters/numerals at 1x = QUALITY-FAIL (hard test: real characters readable at 4x); zoom-only ambiguity at 4x = ADVISORY, only at 8x+ = note; figure-shaped speck reading as a figure at 1x or 2x = QUALITY-FAIL; no hands/weapons/blood; hard fact out of frame/implied = OK with note; position text or Addendum B identity (soft, writer's assumption) visibly contradicted = SCRIPT-DRIFT; hard trait (Layer A) contradicted = SCRIPT-MISS; near-dup that does not fix the take-1 miss = DRIFT; mirrored layout = note; storeys where facade in view; variety never marked down; each variant judged independently.

# Hard-rule findings: NONE. L11 oval (Z_8 hard-rule candidate): a dark oval badge centred on the three-bar grille ~x430-505,y395-420, visible as a shape at 1x; at 4x and 8x (plain and autocontrast) it is uniformly blank - no characters, no blue fill, no inner script or outline glyphs -> ADVISORY under the brief's 'blank oval ... no characters' rule (flagged: body + oval sit where a real maker's police-utility emblem sits; Claude Q2 / Z_8 Q2). L09/L10 grille centres: mesh irregularity only at 8x autocontrast (note). L12 hood leading-edge centre ~x480,y380 small glyph-like badge: not readable as real characters at 4x or 12x autocontrast, maker unidentifiable -> ADVISORY. No readable text/numerals anywhere (plates absent or blank recesses; L08 lamp globe blank 4x; houses no numbers 2-3x). Figures: none read at 1x/2x in any still; L13 pale upright ~5x12px shape at far left kerb ~x605,y398 ambiguous at 4x (likely post/mailbox) -> ADVISORY; L14 far right roadside dark post-like blob ~x888,y393 and park canopy shape ~x1205,y395 not figure-shaped (note). Cabins (L09-L12, gamma/autocontrast 3-4x) show headrests/steering wheel only, nobody. No police equipment on any SUV (no light bar, push bar, spotlight, antennas, lettering, decals). No weapons, blood, body.
